MikroTik 2.5in SATA 16GB SSD Legacy x86 RouterOS 64bit License (Pre-Install) Level 6

The MikroTik 2.5in SATA 16GB SSD Legacy x86 RouterOS 64bit License (Pre-Install) Level 6 is an efficient and reliable storage solution designed for MikroTik routers and servers. With 16GB of storage, this SSD provides sufficient space for essential network configurations, software, and updates, making it an excellent choice for small to medium-scale network environments. This SSD is built to work seamlessly with Legacy BIOS boot mode, ensuring compatibility with older MikroTik systems. It is optimized for use with PC MikroTik machines and other supported MikroTik server machines, ensuring smooth integration into existing network setups. The SSD is pre-installed with RouterOS version v6.48, which is a powerful, feature-rich operating system designed for network management, security, and routing tasks. The device offers OS version updates and downgrades, giving users the flexibility to maintain the system with the latest features or revert to previous versions based on specific network requirements. The pre-activated MikroTik Level 6 license enables access to advanced RouterOS features, including high-performance routing, robust firewall security, VPN services, and more, making it suitable for a wide range of networking applications. Available in various capacities—16GB, 32GB, 64GB, and 128GB—this SSD allows users to choose the right size based on their performance and storage needs. Additionally, it comes with technical support and warranty coverage, offering peace of mind with reliable customer service and protection against defects. The MikroTik 2.5in SATA 16GB SSD provides a cost-effective, efficient storage solution for MikroTik-powered routers and servers, ensuring excellent performance, reliability, and flexibility in managing network infrastructure.

MikroTik 2.5in SATA 16GB SSD Legacy x86 RouterOS 64bit License Features

  • 2.5in SATA Solid State Drive
  • Legacy BIOS Boot Mode
  • Build with PC Mikrotik Machine
  • Supported Server Mikrotik Machine
  • Capacity Available: 16GB / 32GB /64GB/ 128GB
  • OS Version Update and Downgrade Support
  • OS Version v6.48 Pre-Install
  • Technical and Warranty Support
